info.title: Universe Portfolio API
info.description:
Read-only address portfolio and intelligence.

Every answer carries an evidence envelope naming what each source
said. A protocol statement with an empty holdings list is only
meaningful under the `proven` state; under any other state the
empty list is the absence of an answer, not the absence of
holdings. No quantity, price, or total is ever a JSON number:
they are exact decimal strings.

get.summary: The chain and network pairs this API serves.
The portfolio summary with its evidence envelope.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: The chain the address is read on. Never inferred from the address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The address, validated against the chain it is read on.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior response. Carries one position per authority.

200.description: The summary and a continuation cursor when more remains.

400.description: The address, cursor, or a filter is malformed.

404.description: The chain and network pair is not served.

503.description: The service could not answer at all.

get.summary: CSV and JSON renderings of what the portfolio proved.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: The chain the address is read on. Never inferred from the address.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: The address, validated against the chain it is read on.

200.description: The export as an attachment. CSV fields are defended against spreadsheet formula injection.

400.description: The address, cursor, or a filter is malformed.

404.description: The chain and network pair is not served.

503.description: The service could not answer at all.

SourceState.description: How completely one source answered. None of these may be read as a zero balance, and an empty holdings list is only meaningful under `proven`.

ProtocolId.description: A public protocol identity from the Universe registry.

assetId.description: The protocol's own stable identifier. Never a display name.

stale.description: A stale observation is shown but excluded from every total.

assetKey.description: chain:network:protocol:assetType:assetId. The assetId may itself contain colons, so the key parses by fixed segment count.

quantityAtomic.description: Exact atomic quantity as a decimal string, or null when the source stated none. Never a JSON number.

mediaContentId.description: Reference the media proxy resolves. Never a URL the page fetches directly.

value.description: Exact decimal value in the price quote currency. Absent when unpriced.

lagAtomic.description: Blocks behind the chain reference, when both are known.

detail.description: What the authority said about its own state, when it said anything.

EvidenceEnvelope.description: Carried by every answer. A total cannot be read correctly without it.

ProtocolStatement.description: One protocol answer. Branch on `state` before reading `holdings`: an empty list means nothing on its own.

ValuationCoverage.description: Every total states how much of it is priced. A displayed value never silently excludes holdings.

feePaidAtomic.description: Present only when this address paid the fee.

counterparty.description: Named only when the transaction shape identifies exactly one. Never a guess.

value.description: Null when no price exists for that day. Never zero.

PnlReport.description: FIFO from the first transaction. Unknown cost is carried and counted, never valued at zero.

unrealizedPnl.description: Null when no fresh current price exists.

analytics.description: Win rate, winner and loser averages, best and worst realization, return distribution, daily calendar, and quantity-weighted holding period. A statistic with no known-basis population is null rather than zero.

state.description: Present instead of figures when no defensible report can be produced.
